The SVG path uses two elliptical arc commands with the same radii (31.40, 31.40), both drawing arcs from one point to another and back to the start, forming a closed shape. Since the x-radius and y-radius are equal (31.40), this is actually a circular arc, not an elliptical one. The path starts and ends at the same point after tracing two arcs, completing a full circle.  

Final answer: (A)
